text:
Maya: Heads-up: planning a canary deploy for inference-service v3.2.0 tomorrow 16:30 UTC. Ramps: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m soak between steps. Smoke checks + rollback plan in thread. @Sam @Jon @Priya please ack.
Jon: Ack. I can be on watch for first two ramps. Which cohorts are in the 5%?
Maya: 5% = internal + 10% of PLG free-tier users in us-west-2. 20% adds 25% of PLG paid. We'll exclude enterprise accounts behind dedicated envs. Selection by user_segment tag.
Priya: I'll run synthetic prompts for the smoke checks. Sharing probe set in a sec.
Maya: Probe set: `smoke_prompts_v3.json` (small). Smoke checks: latency p50 < 220ms, error rate < 0.3% over 5m.
Priya: Uploading link: https://artifacts.redwood/smoke_prompts_v3.json
Sam: @Maya I'll watch dashboards (latency, error_rate, token_cost) and keep Slack thread updated. Set alerts to page if error_rate > 0.5%.
Lukas: Feature flag? Are we using `ff-inference-v3` toggle or rollout by routing policy?
Maya: Routing policy: canary route in front of inference-service, not feature flag. But we can flip `ff-inference-v3` to isolate if needed.
Jon: Rollback command handy to paste? Better to have quick kill switch.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: inference-service v3.2.0 by @Maya, 2026-03-18 16:30 UTC, canary ramps configured.
Maya: Rollback steps: 1) Pause canary: `POST /deploys/{id}/pause` 2) Route back to v3.1: `POST /routing/switch` 3) If urgent: `DELETE /services/inference-service/v3.2.0`. Ops runbook: https://docs.redwood/rollbacks
Priya: I'll run smoke script: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/dev/smoke -d @smoke_prompts_v3.json | jq .summary```
Sam: I'll keep a 30m watch after 50% ramp. Ping me if you need manual rollback.
Jon: Do we want canary followers? e.g., route 5% to canary, and mirror 100% traffic as shadow? Instrumentation weights?
Maya: We'll mirror 10% of traffic for full request logs to avoid performance impact — good call.
Lukas: SLO owners notified? cc @slo-oncall
Maya: @slo-oncall notified. Also set temporary alert thresholds + mute noisy alerts.
Sam: One more ask: can someone confirm infra has spare GPUs for bursts? @eng-infra
Priya: Confirmed with infra earlier today — autoscale headroom 20%.
Jon: Perfect. I'll be ready at T-10 to run final smoke.
Maya: Thanks. Will post the deploy-id in here when started. ETA 16:30 UTC tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-service v3.2.0 canary id=deploy-20260318-001
Maya: Canary 5% live. Running smoke now.
Priya: Smoke done: all pass. latency p50=185ms, error_rate=0.08% :tada:
Sam: Dashboard looks clean, proceeding to 20% in 5m.
Jon: 20% ramped. Monitoring.
Sam: 50% scheduled in 15m.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 5%->20%->50%
Maya: At 50%—observability ok. No regressions. Proceed to 100% in 30m unless objections.
Lukas: No objections.
Jon: No issues from my side.
Priya: Smoke set passed during 50% as well.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: 100% traffic on v3.2.0. Deploy status: SUCCESS
Maya: Marked as GA. Thanks everyone. I'll update release notes and close the rollout doc.
